0: You will always go first in combat. On your turn you can choose to play cards, attempt to flee, or pass your turn.
1: The goal in combat is to reduce your enemy's HP to 0 and to prevent the same fate from happening to you.
2: When you begin combat, you will draw 4 cards from your deck to begin. Every subsequent turn you will draw 1 additional card from your deck.
3: Hovering over a card will give you more information about that card.
4: Focus represents the Focus Cost to play this card.
5: At the start of each turn you regain your Focus which you can spend to play potion cards. Each potion card has an associated Focus Cost to play it.
6: Charges represents the number of times this potion can be played before it needs refilled at an alchemy workbench. Always consider the cost of empty potion bottles in your deck!
7: The Potencies list shows all of the effects this potion has when played.
8: RED = Damage, BLUE = Frost, ORANGE = Scorch, BROWN = Blight, YELLOW = Ward, GREEN = Mending or Restoration
9: That last attack afflicted you with Scorch!
10: The Scorch status effect can stack. Scorch will deal the number of stacks that is applied on a creature at the end of every combatants turn as Heat damage.
11: Every time damage is dealt, the number of stacks is reduced by 1.
12: All Damage has a TYPE. You can see the type
